description: Head-movement mini-game G07: steady-head challenge, voice-guided. Tap start, settle for 1 second, then hold the head completely still for 10 continuous seconds. Stillness is the total angular change from the orientation captured at attempt start, from the AbsoluteOrientationSensor quaternion, under 5 degrees; a wobble under 0.3 seconds does not reset, sustained movement resets the timer to 0 and restarts the attempt automatically; after 5 resets in one round the game suggests a rest and returns to ready. No turning at all, no camera, no mic/ASR.
name: steady-hold
